vars.prTitle: fix(calendars): don't guess the primary calendar of a connection
vars.prBody: `getConnectedCalendars` fell back to the first calendar of a connection when the provider didn't flag one as primary. That calendar is often a shared or secondary one, yet we showed it as the account's primary calendar and copied its email into `destinationCalendar.primaryEmail`. We now only use the calendar the provider marks as primary, and otherwise return the existing "No primary calendar found" error for the connection.
vars.goldenComments: [{"comment": "getConnectedCalendars now requires some IntegrationCalendar with `primary: true`, but several Calendar implementations never report one. The CalDAV base class used by Apple and CalDAV (packages/lib/CalendarService.ts listCalendars, line 526) sets `primary` only when it is given an event whose destinationCalendar matches, and getConnectedCalendars calls `calendar.listCalendars()` with no event (packages/core/CalendarManager.ts:60), so every calendar comes back `primary: false`; the ICS feed implementation (packages/app-store/ics-feedcalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts listCalendars, line 277) doesn't set `primary` at all. Every Apple/CalDAV/ICS connection is now returned as an error with no `calendars`, so users can no longer pick those calendars for conflict checking, and setDestinationCalendar.handler.ts (allCals is built from `cal.calendars ?? []`) throws `Could not find calendar` when they try to make one the destination calendar.", "severity": "High"}]
